content: Dɑfidin womu ɡe u wom kowobun wiruɡii kuɑ.
U ɡu kuɑwɑ sɑnɑm mɛ Dɔɛɡu Edɔmu u nɑ Sɔɔlun mi u kɑ nùn sɔ̃ mɑ Dɑfidi u dɑ Akimɛlɛkin mi. Womu ɡe wee.

content.text: Tɑbu durɔ, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ ɑ tii siɑrɑmɔ kɔ̃sɑ ye ɑ mɔ̀n sɔ̃.
A n yɛ̃ mɑ Gusunɔn durom mu ko n wɑ̃ɑ sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ.
Kɔ̃sɑ tɔnɑwɑ wunɛn yɑrɑ yɑ rɑ n ɡerumɔ.
Yɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe wobu te tɑ nɔɔ do, murɑfiti wunɛ,
ɑ rɑ kɔ̃sɑ kɑ̃ n kere ɡeɑ,
kpɑ ɑ n weesu kĩ n kere ɡem.
Gɑri kɔ̃siyɑ yi rɑ n yibɑ wunɛn nɔɔwɔ
kpɑ ɑ n wɑ̃ɑ keetɑn swɛɛ sɔɔ.
Yen sɔ̃, ɑ n yɛ̃ mɑ Gusunɔ u koo nun surɑ sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ.
U koo nun ɡɑwɑ u yɑrɑ sɑɑ wunɛn kuu bekuruɡirun di,
kpɑ u nun wunɑ wɑsobun suunu sɔɔn di.
Be bɑ Gusunɔ nɑɑnɛ sɑ̃ɑ, bɑ koo nun wɑ,
kpɑ biti bu mwɑ bu nun yɛ̃ɛ bu nɛɛ,
durɔ winiwɑ u yinɑ Gusunɔ u nùn kɔ̃su,
mɑ u win nɑɑnɛ doke win dukiɑ sɔɔ,
u tii kɔ̃su win bwisi sɔɔ.
Nɛ, nɑ wɑ̃ɑwɑ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ
nɡe olifin dɑ̃ɑ beku te tɑ kpɑre, tɑ wɛ̃su sɑ̃ɑ.
Nɑ win durom nɑɑnɛ sɑ̃ɑ sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ.
Nɑ kon nùn siɑrɑwɑ sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ, domi u kuɑ.
Wi sɔɔrɑ kon nɛn yĩiyɔbu doke be bɑ nùn nɑɑnɛ sɑ̃ɑn suunu sɔɔ
yèn sɔ̃ u sɑ̃ɑ tɔn ɡeo.
